patch_description: The current program spends substantial time recombining and generating large proposal sets, while its energy-and-diversity ranking can favor moves that do not relieve LP bottlenecks. This version limits initial LP evaluation to 24 diverse repairs, keeps a compact elite archive, and ranks local moves using both link prices/loads and demand before consulting energy. It alternates two-edge switches with three-edge rotations, increasing the rotation share after repeated unproductive batches and resetting it after an improvement. Small batches and bounded proposal generation reduce overhead while preserving exploratory moves.
